executive_delta: Runtime blueprint and provider-neutral contracts were delivered in session 1 and re-verified in every session since. This packet exists because AC-05 requires one and none had ever been emitted: the artifacts were published but never reported through the mechanism the ledger consumes, which is why BACKLOG.json still shows this task as READY rather than REVIEW.

facts.claim: The contracts package typechecks under strict mode plus six additional flags with exit code 0.
The runtime invariant suite passes 34 of 34 tests and the full contract suite passes 138 of 138.

The textual loop detector is evadable by changing a single token: Jaccard similarity measured at 0.7778 on a nine-token mission and 0.9130 on a twenty-three-token mission, both under the 0.95 threshold.
The original idempotency key construction was ambiguous: two different field splits hashed to the same key. Corrected with length-prefixed encoding and pinned by a regression test.
L5 Broad Autonomy is not representable in the type system, so it cannot be reached through a configuration mistake.

assumptions.statement: Persistence, transport and artifact storage remain undecided; the contracts are written to survive any of the proposed choices.
assumptions.validation: ADR-RUN-01 through ADR-RUN-06 are recorded as proposed, not decided, in RUNTIME_BLUEPRINT.md section 12.

assumptions.statement: The loop detector is an early-warning signal, not a security control, and must receive no mitigation credit in the risk register.
assumptions.validation: The thresholds are pinned by executable tests so a later session cannot retune them silently.

decisions_proposed.proposal: Fix DepthGuard defaults at depth 3, fan-out 5 and 25 active tasks, not modifiable by agents.
